summary: The engine that keeps every repository on this account moving forward: it measures what each one can currently do, ranks where the headroom is, and refuses to record work that no check actually verified.
key_features: Twelve signals that measure a repository without executing anything inside it, each returning the evidence behind its number and null rather than a guess
Work records with three rules enforced in code: advanced needs the commit to have moved, advanced needs a check that ran and exited zero, no-change needs a stated reason
A fenced check runner with allowlisted verbs, no shell, a scrubbed environment and a timeout, so a command cannot grow a second half it did not declare
Rounds that cover every repository once before anything is revisited, with unchanged repositories sinking to the back of the queue

social.headline: A ratchet only turns one way: measure what a repository can do, rank the headroom, and refuse to record work nobody verified.

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository; the test count is the number the runner printed
